rec.name: UGC Customer Photo & Review Section
rec.status: Freebie copy drafted (lead-magnet text only); build status not confirmed in ticket

what.text: A free, app-free Shopify section that shows real customer photos in a gallery. Each photo can optionally carry a rating and a short customer quote. It is added and arranged through drag-and-drop in the Theme Editor, works on mobile, and is SEO-friendly.

why.text: People trust other customers more than they trust brands. Photos from real buyers show the product 'in real life', which makes the brand's own imagery more credible and lowers purchase doubt. The ticket cites a conversion lift of up to 91% from UGC (source given only as 'Nielsen, etc.'). That figure is unverified and should not be treated as an expected result.

how.text: Add the section to a Home or PDP template in the Theme Editor. Upload customer photos as blocks, and optionally add a star rating and review text to each one. The ticket promises no app and no custom code. Placement near the product info or reviews on the PDP, or mid-page on Home, is a sensible default, but the ticket does not specify it.

dependencies.text: No apps required. Assumes an Online Store 2.0 theme with section and block support in the Theme Editor. Customer photos and consent to use them must be sourced manually. Metafields are not mentioned.

items: Conversion rate on pages with the section vs. without
Click-through or interaction rate on UGC items
